title: Access to Neighbouring Land Act 1993 (Appointed Day) Order 1993
text:
Statutory Document No. 445/93
THE ACCESS TO NEIGHBOURING LAND ACT 1993
THE ACCESS TO NEIGHBOURING LAND ACT 1993
(APPOINTED DAY) ORDER 1993
In exercise of the powers conferred on the Council of Ministers by section 8(2) of the
Access to Neighbouring Land Act 1993(a), and of all other enabling powers, the
following Order is hereby made:—
Citation
1. This Order may he cited as the Access to Neighbouring Land Act 1993
(Appointed Day) Order 1993.
Commencement of the Act
2. The Access to Neighbouring Land Act 1993 shall come into operation on the 1st
November 1993.
MADE 2.3(cid:9) Flo ar(cid:9) 1993
(a) 1993 c.16
EXPLANATORY NOTE
(This note is not part of the Order.)
This Order brings the Access to Neighbouring Land Act 1993 into force on the
1st November 1993.
